Job Description 
 The Role
 General Motors is seeking a Data Scientist to join the AI/ML Solutions team within GPSC Finance. This role develops and improves data products, predictive models, and AI capabilities that strengthen cost intelligence, automate workflows, and support financial, product, and program decisions.
 The Data Scientist will translate business questions into practical analytical and technical solutions within defined projects. They will own assigned deliverables across data preparation, modeling, application development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, working under general supervision with limited guidance. Assigned problems are typically well-defined and moderate in scope; novel or ambiguous problems are escalated to or solved in partnership with senior technical contributors. They will handle typical technical requests independently and partner with senior technical contributors on unfamiliar problems, architecture decisions, and broader solution design.
 The successful candidate will apply data science, software development, and data engineering skills to engineering, supplier, manufacturing, and financial data. The focus is on delivering reliable, governed capabilities that improve financial decisions, reduce manual effort, and become part of daily business workflows.

 
 What You Will Do
 ·         Partner with Engineering, Cost Engineering, Purchasing, Finance, Program Management, and other stakeholders to clarify business questions, document requirements, and define success measures for assigned work.
 ·         Develop, test, and improve predictive, statistical, and machine-learning models, including ensemble methods that combine multiple models, for use cases such as part-cost estimation, cost-driver analysis, forecasting, classification, optimization, and decision support.
 ·         Build and maintain data pipelines that integrate engineering, purchasing, supplier, manufacturing, and financial data using established platform and architecture patterns.
 ·         Preprocess and analyze large structured and unstructured datasets to discover trends and patterns, implement business rules, and validate joins, transformations, assumptions, and outputs with subject matter experts.
 ·         Write modular, testable Python and SQL code for data preparation, modeling, automation, and reusable analytical components.
 ·         Develop analytical applications, APIs, dashboards, or visualizations that make data and model outputs usable by business partners.
 ·         Contribute to AI capabilities for natural-language access to cost data, document processing, engineering workflow automation, and decision support. Apply approved patterns for large language models, retrieval, tool calling, and structured outputs where appropriate.
 ·         Implement data-quality checks, model evaluations, documentation, and monitoring to sustain model effectiveness over time. Investigate non-routine issues in existing pipelines and models, resolve issues within the assigned scope, and escalate broader risks or design changes.
 ·         Use Git, automated testing, and established CI/CD and MLOps practices to help move validated solutions into production and support their ongoing operation.
 ·         Coordinate with cross-functional colleagues to deliver assigned work, communicate dependencies and trade-offs, and propose solutions and improvements to existing methods and workflows that drive business impact.
 ·         Present complex findings, limitations, recommendations, and business value to technical and non-technical audiences using data visualization techniques. Incorporate user feedback to improve usability and adoption.
 ·         Follow GM requirements for data protection, responsible AI, security, governance, and model risk management throughout development and support.

 
 Required Qualifications
 ·         Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, operations research, physics, or a related quantitative discipline.
 ·         Relevant hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, data engineering, applied analytics, or a related technical role.
 ·         Proficiency in Python, including writing modular, testable, and maintainable code.
 ·         Strong working knowledge of SQL, including querying, joining, transforming, and validating relational data.
 ·         Experience preparing complex datasets, building or maintaining data pipelines, and implementing data-quality checks.
 ·         Applied understanding of statistics and machine learning, with experience selecting, building, and evaluating models for business problems.
 ·         Experience using Databricks or another modern cloud-based data and machine-learning platform.
 ·         Experience using version control, testing, documentation, and reproducible development practices, with a working understanding of deployment and monitoring.
 ·         Demonstrated hands-on capability in the following areas:
 o   Predictive modeling, forecasting, optimization, or decision science.
 o   Data engineering and reusable analytical data products.
 o   Large language model applications, document intelligence, or information extraction.
 o   Computer vision, multimodal machine learning, or engineering-data analysis.
 ·         Ability to translate defined business questions into data and modeling tasks, validate results, and explain assumptions and limitations.
 ·         Ability to deliver assigned work independently within agreed priorities, troubleshoot technical issues, and recognize when additional guidance is needed.
 ·         Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and business partners.

 Preferred Qualifications
 ·         Master’s degree or higher in a related quantitative discipline.
 ·         Experience contributing to the deployment, monitoring, or support of analytical or machine-learning products in production.
 ·         Experience in automotive engineering, product development, purchasing, supply chain, manufacturing, finance, or cost engineering.
 ·         Experience with cost-estimation, should-cost, sourcing, supplier-risk, profitability, or financial-risk analysis.
 ·         Experience developing analytical applications, APIs, dashboards, or visualizations using FastAPI, Flask, Dash, Streamlit, Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, or similar tools.
 ·         Experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, Text-to-SQL, tool calling, structured outputs, or AI evaluation.
 ·         Experience processing supplier quotes, cost breakdowns, technical documents, part images, CAD-related data, or 3D geometry.
 ·         Experience with PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Databricks Workflows, Databricks Asset Bundles, or related capabilities.
 ·         Experience connecting analytical work to measurable improvements in cost, efficiency, adoption, or decision quality.


GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc).

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.

This job is not eligible for relocation benefits. Any relocation costs would be the responsibility of the selected candidate.

 About GM 
 Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
 
 Why Join Us  
 We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.
 
 Benefits Overview 
 From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources .
 
 Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.) 
 General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.
 
 All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. 
 
 We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire .
 
 Accommodations 
 General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.
